experiment: P3o-A low-power attribution: coverage, joint checkpoint, and CP-safe calibration
loss: BCEWithLogits + 0.1 masked SmoothL1; no hard-negative, conditional margin, router, distillation, or new expert

checkpoint_rules.C_joint: maximum early macro-AUPR among epochs within 1.01x C_param NMAE

threshold_rules.T_safe: ISRJ lowest threshold with every regime-power calibration cell CP95 FPR upper <= 0.10

development_access_rule: No data-role, generator, model, loss, optimizer, epoch budget, checkpoint, threshold, confidence-bound cap or gate change after seed860000000 predictions are opened.
mechanical_correction_after_data_generat: Corrected predicted-gate parameter metrics to use each active class's predicted label rather than applying the ISRJ gate to all twelve parameters. Added a regression test. This conforms to the frozen predicted-label gate definition and changes no model, loss, data, training, checkpoint, threshold, CP cap, or promotion gate.
